description: Official mortgage rates as JSON, no API key: US 30-year and 15-year fixed (Freddie Mac PMMS, weekly since 1971), Canada 1/3/5-year conventional + prime (Bank of Canada), UK 2/3/5/10-year fixed and variable (Bank of England) and the cost of borrowing for house purchase in 21 euro countries by fixation period (ECB). Latest with change and 1-year change, history, cheapest-country compare. Monitor mode returns only new publications. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/mortgage-rates-api.

country.description: ISO country codes, for example US, GB, CA, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL. UK, EA (euro area = U2) and full names like Germany also work. Empty = all 25 (latest/compare). Required for history.

endDate.description: For history: last date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Default today.

frequency.description: For history: native (weekly for US/Canada, monthly for UK/euro), monthly or yearly (last observation of each period).

limit.description: Maximum rows returned for history (newest kept). Between 1 and 20000.

mode.description: latest = newest rate of every country/product with previous value, change and 1-year change; history = past observations of the chosen countries (needs Country); compare = one headline rate per country sorted cheapest first (US 30-year fixe

product.description: Optional filter: 30y-fixed, 15y-fixed, 5-1-arm, 1y-fixed, 2y-fixed, 3y-fixed, 5y-fixed, 10y-fixed, 2y-fixed-95ltv, 2y-variable, tracker, all-fixation, floating-1y, 1-5y-fixed, 5-10y-fixed, over-10y-fixed, prime-rate, policy-rate. US: 30y-fi

sort.description: For latest: country (default), rate (cheapest first), rate_desc, change (biggest fall first).

startDate.description: For history: first date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Default = full history.

name: mortgage_rates_api
title: Mortgage Rates API - US, UK, Canada, Eurozone Official Data
